metadata.title: HOLONG SIKI Tribal TEMPLE, TRIPURA | होलोंग सिकी माता मंदिर, त्रिपुरा
metadata.description: Tripura has 19 tribal groups and these groups have there own religious belief system. But Holon Siki, temple on the hill top in west Tripura District is considered a sacred place by every tribe here. On the shiv ratri every year thousands of Tiprasa people gather here to do annual puja in the temple.
